installCommand: mkdir -p python_libs api/_libs ; (uv pip install --system -r requirements.txt 2>&1 ; pip install --target python_libs -r requirements.txt 2>&1 ; pip install --target api/_libs -r requirements.txt 2>&1 ; pip install --break-system-packages -r requirements.txt 2>&1 ; echo DONE_PYTHON) && cd web && npm install
